wargear.name: Vigil banner
wargear.summary: A Sodality's colours, gilded by ten thousand years of ceremony.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Vigil banner, all Models in that Unit add 1 to their Willpower and Leadership Characteristics.

wargear.name: Ablative gilding
wargear.summary: A layered auramite coating that sheds blows as a second skin.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Ablative gilding has an Invulnerable Save of 5+, unless it already has a better Invulnerable Save.

wargear.name: Mantle of the Silent
wargear.summary: A hunter's cloak woven with null-fibre that dims the wearer to the senses.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Mantle of the Silent has the Shrouded (6+) Special Rule.

wargear.name: Reliquary plate
wargear.summary: A sarcophagus-ward of auramite lined with the names of the Dreadnought's former masters.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with Reliquary plate adds 1 to its Wounds Characteristic.

wargear.name: Null-gilt pylon
wargear.summary: A null-lattice pylon worn at the shoulder, humming against the warp.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Null-gilt pylon adds 1 to its Willpower Characteristic and has the Warp-Sealed Special Rule.

wargear.name: Oathstone of Reckoning
wargear.summary: A fist-sized stone engraved with the names of the fallen, carried by captains who never forget.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with an Oathstone of Reckoning has the Vengeance Sworn Special Rule.

wargear.name: Banner of the Last Gate
wargear.summary: A tall standard that marks where the line will not move.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with a Banner of the Last Gate, all Models in that Unit have the Hold the Gate Special Rule.

wargear.name: Mirror-gold gilding
wargear.summary: Polished auramite plating that throws back the light of beams and melta-glare.
wargear.text: A Vehicle equipped with Mirror-gold gilding adds 1 to its Rear Armour Value and has the Mirror-Gold Hull Special Rule.

wargear.name: Edict-staff of the Vestarios
wargear.summary: A staff of office bearing the Emperor's own seal, obeyed without question.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with an Edict-staff of the Vestarios, all Models in that Unit have the Voice of the Throne Special Rule.

wargear.name: Auric sighting-glass
wargear.summary: A lens-and-rangefinder wrought by the Emperor's own artisans.
wargear.text: While a Unit includes a Model equipped with an Auric sighting-glass, all Models in that Unit have the Throne's Eye Special Rule.

wargear.name: Soul-lamp of the Entombed
wargear.summary: A lamp lit from the Dreadnought's own fading memory.
wargear.text: A Model equipped with a Soul-lamp of the Entombed has the Feel No Pain (6+) and Lamp of Remembrance Special Rules.

wargear.name: Additional Pallas Grav-Attack (fusil)
wargear.summary: Another Pallas flies with the squadron, armed as the first.
wargear.text: The Unit includes one more Pallas Grav-Attack with the same Characteristics, Special Rules and Weapons as the first, armed with a Centreline Mounted Twin Iliastus accelerator fusil. It must stay in Unit Coherency with the rest of the Unit and is removed as a casualty like any other Model.

wargear.name: Additional Pallas Grav-Attack (blaze cannon)
wargear.summary: Another Pallas flies with the squadron, bearing the Arachnus blaze cannon.
wargear.text: The Unit includes one more Pallas Grav-Attack with the same Characteristics and Special Rules as the first, armed with a Centreline Mounted Twin Arachnus blaze cannon in place of the accelerator fusil. It must stay in Unit Coherency with the rest of the Unit and is removed as a casualty like any other Model.

wargear.name: Additional Pallas Grav-Attack (devastator)
wargear.summary: Another Pallas flies with the squadron, bearing the Adrathic devastators.
wargear.text: The Unit includes one more Pallas Grav-Attack with the same Characteristics and Special Rules as the first, armed with a Centreline Mounted Twin Adrathic devastator in place of the accelerator fusil. It must stay in Unit Coherency with the rest of the Unit and is removed as a casualty like any other Model.

rites.name: Defenders of the Palace
rites.flavor: The Throne is the last thing that falls, and the Ten Thousand are what stands in front of it.
benefits: Adrasite and Pyrithite Guard Sodalities may fill Troops slots.
They gain Line (1) and Unbroken Watch: while within 6" of an Objective Marker they cannot become Pinned or Suppressed.
limitations: A Shield Captain must be included.
Adrasite and Pyrithite Guard Sodalities must deploy within 12" of an objective.
No Fast Attack, Heavy Transport or Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: Defenders of the Palace: Line (1), Unbroken Watch.

require.note: A Shield Captain commands the watch.

rites.name: The Talon Hunt
rites.flavor: Someone in the Palace has a secret. The Ten Thousand and the Talons agree on the remedy.
benefits: Venatari Sodalities may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Assassins gain Talon Writ: after deployment the Controlling Player names one enemy Unit as the Quarry of each Assassin, and that Assassin adds 1 to its Hit Tests against it.
limitations: At least one Venatari Sodality and one Assassin are required.
No War Engine or Lord of War units.

require.note: Bring a Venatari Sodality to run down the quarry.
A Talon of the Emperor must be present.

rites.name: The Emperor's Will
rites.flavor: Valdor does not command the Ten Thousand. He only says aloud what they already know.
benefits: Once per Battle Turn, a Legio Custodes Unit within 12" of Constantin Valdor may make a Reaction without spending one of its Controlling Player's Reactions for that Battle Turn.
They gain Valdor's Word: +1 Leadership and Cool for Panic Checks and Pinning while within 12" of Constantin Valdor.
limitations: Constantin Valdor must lead the army.
No Vagus automata (Castellax, Domitar, Thanatar, Vorax or Vultarax), and at most one War Engine.

rites.name: The Vigil of Ancients
rites.flavor: Within each Contemptor sleeps a warrior who knew the Emperor before He was called that.
benefits: Contemptor-Galatus, Contemptor-Achillus and Telemon Heavy Dreadnoughts may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Wakened Ancients: each adds 1 to its Hit Tests against a Unit that removed a friendly Model as a casualty earlier in the same Phase.
limitations: At least two War Engine units are required.
No Custodian Guard or Sentinel Guard Sodalities.

modifiers.text: The Vigil of Ancients: Line (1), Wakened Ancients.

rules.name: Unbroken Watch
rules.summary: The Watch does not break while the Throne's gates are in sight.
rules.text: While at least one Model in a Unit with this Special Rule is within 6" of an Objective Marker, that Unit cannot gain the Pinned or Suppressed Tactical Statuses.

rules.name: Talon Writ
rules.summary: The Talon is given a name, and does not rest until it is struck from the list.
rules.text: After both Players have deployed, the Controlling Player of each Model with this Special Rule chooses one enemy Unit to be that Model's Quarry. That Model adds 1 to the result of every Hit Test it makes against its Quarry.

rules.name: Valdor's Word
rules.summary: The Captain-General speaks once, and the Ten Thousand hold.
rules.text: While any Model in a Unit with this Special Rule is within 12" of Constantin Valdor, all Models in that Unit add 1 to their Leadership and Cool Characteristics when taking Panic Checks and Cool Checks made for Pinning.

rules.name: Wakened Ancients
rules.summary: The old warriors in the sarcophagi wake angry when comrades fall.
rules.text: When a Model with this Special Rule makes a Hit Test against a Unit that removed one or more friendly Models as casualties earlier in the same Phase, it adds 1 to the result.

rules.name: Warp-Sealed
rules.summary: Null-fibre and Throne-sealed wards make the bearer a poor target for sorcery.
rules.text: The first Wound allocated to a Model with this Special Rule by a Psychic Power in each Phase is discarded.

rules.name: Vengeance Sworn
rules.summary: The Custodes do not forget a name, and they do not forgive one.
rules.text: When a friendly Legio Custodes Model within 6" of a Model with this Special Rule is removed as a casualty, the Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic until the end of that Battle Turn.

rules.name: Hold the Gate
rules.summary: Here the line stands, and here the line stays.
rules.text: While a Unit with this Special Rule is within 3" of an Objective Marker, each of its Models counts as two Models when determining which Unit Controls that Objective, and the Unit cannot gain the Pinned Tactical Status. A Unit with this Special Rule cannot Rush.

rules.name: Mirror-Gold Hull
rules.summary: Polished auramite throws the killing light back at the gunner.
rules.text: Shooting Attacks that target a Model with this Special Rule do not benefit from the Armourbane or Melta (X) Special Rules of the Weapons used.

rules.name: Voice of the Throne
rules.summary: An edict that carries the Emperor's seal is not argued with.
rules.text: Once per battle, at the start of any Phase, a Unit with this Special Rule may remove the Pinned, Suppressed, Stunned or Routed Tactical Status from itself.

rules.name: Throne's Eye
rules.summary: A lens that sees what the Emperor's artisans wished it to see.
rules.text: Models in a Unit with this Special Rule ignore the Shrouded (X) Special Rule of their targets when making a Shooting Attack, and add 1 to the result of Hit Tests made against Models with the Flyer Sub-Type.

rules.name: Lamp of Remembrance
rules.summary: The lamp burns brighter when the Dreadnought is guarding something worth the dying.
rules.text: While an Objective Marker is within 12" of a Model with this Special Rule, its Feel No Pain Damage Mitigation Test has a Target Number of 5+ instead of 6+.

rules.name: Stubborn
rules.summary: Hard to frighten, and harder to move.
rules.text: When a Unit that includes any Model with this Special Rule makes a Cool Check or a Panic Check, it ignores all negative modifiers to the Characteristic used.

rules.name: Relentless
rules.summary: The Unit never slows to aim and never slows to strike.
rules.text: A Unit made up entirely of Models with this Special Rule treats its Models as Stationary when making a Shooting Attack with a Weapon that has the Heavy (X) or Ordnance (X) Special Rule, even if they Moved earlier in the same Battle Turn. Such a Unit may also declare a Charge in a Battle Turn in which it made a Shooting Attack.

armyRules.name: Aurum Discipline
armyRules.flavor: Ten thousand years of drill leave the Custodes unmoved by terror, and unable to yield.
benefits: A Unit with this Special Rule is not affected by the Pinning (X) Special Rule of enemy Weapons.
drawbacks: A Unit with this Special Rule can never make a Fall Back Move voluntarily.

armyRules.name: Peerless Duellist
armyRules.flavor: The Emperor's champions are trained for single combat above all else.
benefits: While Engaged in a Challenge, a Model with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Weapon Skill Characteristic.
drawbacks: A Model with this Special Rule cannot decline a Challenge offered by an enemy Champion or Paragon.

armyRules.name: Irreplaceable
armyRules.flavor: There are so few of them that every loss is felt across the host.
benefits: A Unit with this Special Rule adds 1 to its Combat Resolution Points in each Assault.
drawbacks: Whenever a Legio Custodes Unit is destroyed, every other friendly Legio Custodes Unit within 12" cannot make a Rush Move until the end of the next Battle Turn.

armyRules.name: Bane of Heroes
armyRules.flavor: The Ten Thousand were made to end the galaxy's champions, not its rank and file.
benefits: When a Legio Custodes Model makes attacks in a Combat against an enemy Unit that includes a Model with the Command, Champion or Unique Sub-Type (other than a Primarch), it adds 1 to its Attacks Characteristic and its Hit Tests succeed on a 4+ or better, whatever the Weapon Skill comparison.
drawbacks: A Legio Custodes Unit that could declare a Charge against such an enemy Unit cannot declare a Charge against any other Unit that turn.
armyRules.condition: in a Combat against an enemy Command, Champion or Unique Model (not a Primarch)
